item.title: Summarizing Security Alerts on a Raspberry Pi, Part 1: Inference
item.description: Can a small language model explain security alerts on a Raspberry Pi 5, with nothing sent to the cloud? It can, but the runtime matters more than the model, and long prompts hurt some models much more than others. [14 min read]

item.title: Summarizing Security Alerts on a Raspberry Pi, Part 2: Fine-Tuning and Evaluation
item.description: This is the second part of our post about small language models for summarizing security alerts on a Raspberry Pi. Here we go into the details: how we fine-tuned the models, how we evaluated them, and a few things to keep in mind when deploying them. [9 min read]

item.title: Using CNN for a Domain name Generation Algorithm (2)
item.description: DGA is a mechanism used by malware for establishing contact with the C2 channel. This is the second post of the series for creating a simple DGA using techniques for text generation. In particular, CNN uses Keras and Tensorflow for R. [6 min read]

item.title: Using CNN for a Domain name Generation Algorithm (1)
item.description: DGA is a mechanism used by malware for establishing contact with the C2 channel. The idea behind this post is to show how to create a simple DGA using techniques for text generation. In particular, CNN using Keras and Tensorflow for R. This is the first part of a series of two. [6 min read]
